findings.title: Verify continuation page for the 大 account
findings.details: Research inspected the original scan for 字源 PDF p. 922 / printed p. 907, but the OCR continuation on PDF p. 923 was not attached or checked. Claims relying on continuation-only text therefore remain unverified against the scan. The reported difference between accounts describing the figure’s arms as spread or hanging is preserved as unresolved; the cited bronze example does not establish a dated adult-to-big sequence.
findings.verification: Inspect the original scan for PDF p. 923 and verify any claims based on its continuation text. Keep the arm-pose disagreement and semantic chronology qualified unless further evidence resolves them.
